title: The House That Never Slept
content:
Never had anyone dared to enter Blackwood Manor on Halloween night. For decades, the abandoned house had stood silently at the edge of the village, surrounded by twisted trees and forgotten graves.

Rarely did the villagers speak about the terrible events that had occurred there many years before. Little did they know that the legend was far more dangerous than they imagined.

On one cold October evening, however, three curious friends decided to investigate the mysterious house. Hardly had they crossed the iron gate when the wind suddenly stopped.

No sooner had they entered the house than the heavy wooden door slammed shut behind them. Under no circumstances were they supposed to return before midnight, according to an old warning carved into the wall.

Inside, strange shadows moved across the corridor. Never before had the friends seen anything so disturbing. Not only did they hear whispers coming from empty rooms, but they also saw candles lighting themselves one by one.

Not until the clock struck midnight did they discover the truth. Hidden beneath the old house was a secret room containing dozens of ancient photographs. In every picture, the same three faces appeared.

Their own faces.

Only then did they realize that Blackwood Manor had been waiting for them all along.

And never again did anyone see the three friends after that Halloween night.
